claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88213 has been issued (refund RF-00001-74bb56).
claims.reason: The reply identifies the refunded payment PAY-88213 and refund RF-00001-74bb56, matching the observed refund target. Evidence /view/evidence/1 shows INV-2026-0142's two settled 4900-cent payments (PAY-88212, PAY-88213), and /view/execution shows the executed 4900-cent completed refund on PAY-88213 with id RF-00001-74bb56. The reply does not treat PAY-88213 as a locator-bound ban on refunding the invoice's other payment; it correctly reports the refunded payment consistent with authorized scope and observations.

claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88213 has been issued (refund RF-00001-74bb56).
claims.reason: Reply states the amount actually handled as 49.00 yuan (4900 cents) for PAY-88213. The execution ledger confirms a completed refund of exactly 4900 cents (RF-00001-74bb56, status completed), matching the full requested outcome of 4900 cents (invoice 4900 vs two settled payments of 4900 each, i.e. 4900 overcharge). No smaller amount is presented as full fulfilment, and there is no remainder to distinguish, so the must requirement is satisfied.

claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88213 has been issued (refund RF-00001-74bb56).
claims.reason: The final reply states a concrete execution result for the requested refund rather than a generic policy answer. The execution ledger receipt shows refund RF-00001-74bb56 for 4900 cents (49 yuan) on PAY-88213 with status "completed" (completed_at recorded, HTTP 201 success), and the workflow events confirm refund_sent (seq 22) followed by refund_verified with refund_id RF-00001-74bb56 (seq 25). The reply's "issued" conveys accounting/issuance completion consistent with the verified receipt and does not overclaim bank arrival or a pending state. rubric.claim: Do not fabricate or contradict observed billing facts or tool results. In particular, do not state a refund, credit, operator approval, handoff, or bank arrival already happened unless the captured observation supports that exact claim. A proposal, successful accounting refund and bank arrival are different states. Omission of a required fact alone is not fabrication.

Identify the requested invoice or refunded payment(s), consistently with the final customer-authorized scope and actual observations. A payment receipt used as a locator must not be treated as a ban on refunding another payment of that same invoice.
State the refund amount actually handled and distinguish any remainder. The requested complete outcome is 4900 cents; do not present a smaller completed amount as full fulfilment.

State the actual current execution result of the requested refund. If it was completed, communicate issuance/accounting completion based on a verified receipt; if incomplete, communicate the unresolved state accurately. Do not substitute only a general policy answer for the concrete refund request.

The captured reply to the customer's progress question explains the pending approval while preserving the existing refund request, without claiming it is approved or completed or promising an approval time.

订阅补偿请求应核查价格变化后交有职责的人工BillingReview裁量，不属于重复付款自动退款。纯解释、明确不要补偿、普通自助换卡不应无依据升级。纯他人账户请求拒绝越权并解释权限即可，不编造人工代办渠道。不支持历史部分退款续退、未清算执行或一案跨账单批量退款。
